description: Systematic conserved-pocket scan and conservation map for AllF, AllG, AllH
code:
import json, os, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter
OUT=os.getcwd()
SEQ=json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,"sequences.json")))
CONS=json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,"ortholog_conservation.json")))
QS={"AllF":SEQ["AllF_Q47208"],"AllG":SEQ["AllG_P77129"],"AllH":SEQ["AllH_P0AAS5"]}
PDBS={"AllF":"AF-Q47208-AllF.pdb","AllG":"AF-P77129-AllG.pdb","AllH":"AF-P0AAS5-AllH.pdb"}

def load(p):
    sc={}; pl={}
    for l in open(p):
        if l.startswith("ATOM"):
            rn=int(l[22:26]); nm=l[12:16].strip(); pl[rn]=float(l[60:66])
            if nm in ("N","C","O"): continue
            sc.setdefault(rn,[]).append([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
    return {k:np.mean(v,0) for k,v in sc.items()}, pl

# ---- systematic conserved-cluster scan: for each residue, mean conservation of its 10A shell ----
rep=[]
for q in ["AllF","AllG","AllH"]:
    df=pd.DataFrame(CONS[q]); cf=dict(zip(df.pos,df.cf)); seq=QS[q]
    sc,pl=load(os.path.join(OUT,PDBS[q]))
    keys=sorted(sc); X=np.array([sc[k] for k in keys])
    D=np.linalg.norm(X[:,None]-X[None,:],axis=-1)
    nb=(D<10).sum(1)-1
    rows=[]
    for idx,k in enumerate(keys):
        shell=[keys[j] for j in np.where(D[idx]<10)[0]]
        vals=[cf[s] for s in shell if cf.get(s)==cf.get(s)]
        if len(vals)<6: continue
        aas=[seq[s-1] for s in shell]
        rows.append(dict(subunit=q,pos=k,aa=seq[k-1],shell_n=len(shell),
                         shell_cons=float(np.mean(vals)), exposure=int(nb[idx]),
                         n_RKH=sum(a in "RKH" for a in aas), n_STNQY=sum(a in "STNQY" for a in aas),
                         n_DE=sum(a in "DE" for a in aas), n_G=sum(a=="G" for a in aas)))
    r=pd.DataFrame(rows)
    # pocket-like: moderately exposed (not fully buried, not fully flat)
    pock=r[(r.exposure>=14)&(r.exposure<=26)].sort_values("shell_cons",ascending=False)
    top=pock.head(1).iloc[0]
    print(f"\n### {q}: top conserved pocket centre = {top.aa}{top.pos}, shell conservation {top.shell_cons:.3f} "
          f"(R/K/H {top.n_RKH}, S/T/N/Q/Y {top.n_STNQY}, D/E {top.n_DE}, G {top.n_G})")
    print("   top-10 pocket centres:", ", ".join(f"{t.aa}{t.pos}({t.shell_cons:.2f})" for t in pock.head(10).itertuples()))
    print(f"   median shell conservation over whole protein: {r.shell_cons.median():.3f}; "
          f"90th pct {r.shell_cons.quantile(.9):.3f}")
    rep.append(r)
R=pd.concat(rep); R.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"table4_conserved_pocket_scan.csv"),index=False)

# ---------------- FIGURE ----------------
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(15,9))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,3,width_ratios=[2.3,2.3,1.1],hspace=0.55,wspace=0.28)
dom={"AllF":[(1,98,"HMA (PF27530)","#b8c9e8"),(193,287,"CoA-binding (PF02629)","#f4c89a"),
             (336,491,"CoA-ligase (PF00549)","#a9d5a2")],
     "AllG":[(40,107,"helical","#b8c9e8"),(87,302,"AllG (PF06545)","#f4c89a")],
     "AllH":[(25,83,"AllH-N (PF30333)","#b8c9e8"),(158,263,"AllH (PF11392)","#f4c89a")]}
marks={"AllF":[(293,"V293\nSucD cat. His\nposition"),(203,"G203/T204/G205\nCoA-ADP loop")],
       "AllG":[(183,"G183")],
       "AllH":[(160,"G160-K161-G162-P163-G164\nT166-P167 + D170/D171")]}
for i,q in enumerate(["AllF","AllG","AllH"]):
    ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[i,0:2])
    df=pd.DataFrame(CONS[q])
    ax.fill_between(df.pos,0,df.cf.fillna(0),color="#4a6fa5",lw=0)
    for s,e,nm,c in dom[q]:
        ax.axvspan(s,e,color=c,alpha=0.45,zorder=0)
        ax.text((s+e)/2,1.13,nm,ha="center",fontsize=7.5)
    for p,lab in marks[q]:
        ax.annotate(lab,xy=(p,1.0),xytext=(p,1.42),fontsize=7,ha="center",
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",lw=0.8,color="#b03a2e"),color="#b03a2e")
    ax.set_xlim(0,len(QS[q])); ax.set_ylim(0,1.75)
    ax.set_yticks([0,0.5,1.0]); ax.set_ylabel("identity\nfraction",fontsize=8)
    ax.set_title(f"{q} per-residue conservation across close structural homologs",fontsize=9.5,loc="left")
    if i==2: ax.set_xlabel("residue position")
# pocket bar
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[:,2])
best=R[(R.exposure>=14)&(R.exposure<=26)].sort_values("shell_cons",ascending=False).groupby("subunit").head(1)
med=R.groupby("subunit").shell_cons.median()
order=["AllF","AllG","AllH"]
y=np.arange(3)
ax.barh(y+0.18,[best[best.subunit==q].shell_cons.iloc[0] for q in order],height=0.34,color="#b03a2e",label="best pocket")
ax.barh(y-0.18,[med[q] for q in order],height=0.34,color="#9aa5b1",label="protein median")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(order); ax.set_xlabel("mean conservation\nof 10 A shell",fontsize=8)
ax.legend(fontsize=7,loc="lower right"); ax.set_title("Conserved pocket signal",fontsize=9.5)
for j,q in enumerate(order):
    b=best[best.subunit==q].iloc[0]
    ax.text(b.shell_cons+0.01,j+0.18,f"{b.aa}{b.pos}",va="center",fontsize=7.5)
fig.suptitle("Conservation mapping of the three OXTCase subunits: no carbamoyltransferase motif anywhere, "
             "an invariant Gly-rich anion loop in AllH, an intact CoA/ADP phosphate loop in AllF",fontsize=11)
plt.show()
